name: 62274 · Pinckneyville, IL
findings: ZIP 62274 (Pinckneyville) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (63%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62274 (Pinckneyville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
37% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 62274 (Pinckneyville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
